Mutations of SOS1, the gene encoding a guanine nucleotide exchange factor for Ras, have been the most recent discoveries in patients with NS, but this gene has not been studied in patients with CFCS.
Missense mutations of SOS1 were discovered in 28% of patients with NS.
In contrast, none of the patients classified as having CFCS was found to carry a pathogenic sequence change in this gene.
CONCLUSION: We have confirmed SOS1 as the second major gene for NS.
